extraction: Verbatim transcription of the published LaTeX table.
note: Herrmann & Ciardullo 2009 Table 3: 'Geometric Parameters for Disk Models'. This IS a piecewise warp geometry: M83 has five radial zones with PA running 226 -> 172 deg and i running 24 -> 46 deg (PA and i vary LINEARLY with R inside the last three zones), and M94 has two zones. IC 342, M74 and M101 use a single constant (PA, i) over the full range. Geometry is set by the HI velocity field, not the PNe.
